svg.title: Bearing defect frequencies 7014 C at 10000 rpm
svg.text: Bearing defect frequencies – front bearing 7014 C at 10 000 rpm (f_r = 166.7 Hz) – ILLUSTRATIVE spectra
assumed example geometry: Z = 20 balls, D_w = 11.112 mm, d_m = 90 mm, α = 15° → D_w·cos α / d_m = 0.1193 (get Z, D_w from the bearing maker!)
Frequencies are calculated; the amplitudes are invented to show what a defect looks like.
A – velocity spectrum (housing, radial) with an OUTER-race defect: peaks at BPFO and harmonics
B – ENVELOPE spectrum (band-pass 5–20 kHz, demodulated) with an INNER-race defect: BPFI with ±1× side bands
BSF = d_m/(2·D_w)·f_r·(1 − r²) = 665 Hz (r = D_w·cos α / d_m) – at 5 000 rpm all values are half
Guide 20 – spindle station live twin · values: examples from the guide / app
